statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail 11% (low), Stress 49% (elevated), Confidence 88% (high). Nasdaq-100 futures are easing back from the top of a narrow overnight band on thin Asian liquidity, with VIX, Treasury yields and crude showing no amplifier alignment ahead of a heavily scheduled U.S. Friday.
recommendation: Tail remains well below the block threshold, so the deterministic mapping resolves to EA_ON for both NQ futures and the NAS100 CFD. The narrow evidence-based danger window is 13:30-16:00 UTC (15:30-18:00 Berlin), covering the U.S. cash open, Chicago PMI and the simultaneous 14:00 UTC Warsh keynote, payroll benchmark revision and final Michigan sentiment, where the mapped forecast state moves to WATCH. Existing-position management and emergency protection are unaffected by this assessment.
headline: Nasdaq-100 futures fade off the overnight band top as Asia splits ahead of Warsh's Jackson Hole keynote
body: The Nasdaq-100 cash index closed Thursday at 29,641.56, up 1.43%, finishing at the upper edge of its 29,366.42-29,643.53 range after Nvidia rose 8.7% on a revenue outlook well above consensus. Leadership was narrow rather than broad. Since the close, NQ futures have held a band of roughly 29,592-29,707, about 0.39% wide, and were last near 29,662.50, down 0.11%, having eased back from the top of that band over the past hour. That retreat is ordinary mean reversion inside a contained range rather than persistent directional efficiency: no failed-retracement sequence has formed, the index is no longer pressing an extreme, and there is no cross-asset confirmation. VIX closed at 14.51, down 4.60%; the 2-year and 10-year constant-maturity Treasury yields were 4.19% and 4.66% in the latest H.15 release, essentially unchanged; WTI is near $83.05 and Brent near $88.17, both slightly softer. The Asian session split rather than trended, with the Nikkei 225 up 0.61% to 66,533.52 on SoftBank strength while the Kospi fell 1.16% to 6,831.99 on AI-chip profit-taking in Samsung and SK Hynix, and Marvell shares sank in extended U.S. trade despite an earnings beat and above-consensus guidance. That leaves a genuinely two-sided semiconductor tone rather than an aligned risk-on regime. Geopolitically, the Iran conflict remains unresolved at day 181, but the 27 August developments - an Iran-Oman corridor revenue-sharing arrangement and a Qatari de-escalation visit to Tehran - point away from new escalation, consistent with softer crude. The day ahead is heavily scheduled: Chicago PMI at 13:45 UTC, then Fed Chair Warsh's first Jackson Hole keynote, the BLS preliminary payroll benchmark revision and final Michigan sentiment all at 14:00 UTC, on a month-end Friday. That concentration raises Stress and justifies a narrow 13:30-16:00 UTC danger window, but pre-event catalyst density is not observed price-path evidence, so Tail stays in the low band. Shared Finviz cross-asset context was available but timestamped 23:14 UTC, more than five hours old, so it was treated as stale and not relied upon; the assessment rests on independently verified current sources.

lookbackSummary: Across the past 24 clock-hours every published Claude assessment stayed in the EA_ON band, with Tail between 10% and 14% and Stress ranging from the mid-40s during the European morning to the low 50s around the U.S. session and overnight. The dominant mode was predominantly mixed, with two trend-up marks at 17:00 and 20:00 UTC as the Nvidia-led advance extended into the cash close, and one unavailable hour at 09:00 UTC on 27 August where no assessment was published. No hour reached the watch band, and the series shows no episode of persistent no-retracement structure over the period.
outlookSummary: The horizon runs from a quiet late-Asian session through the European morning into a concentrated U.S. afternoon and then the weekend futures halt. Conditional risk builds gradually from 06:00 UTC on European participation and month-end flows, steps up at the 13:30 UTC cash open and 13:45 UTC Chicago PMI, and peaks across 14:00-16:00 UTC on the Warsh keynote, the payroll benchmark revision and final Michigan sentiment, where the mapped state moves to WATCH before decaying back to EA_ON. Scores normalise through the U.S. afternoon, rise modestly into the 20:00 UTC month-end close, and then fall to their weekend floor once CME equity-index futures halt at 21:00 UTC, with confidence stepping down through the halt because no live price path exists to assess.
